name: Як це називається? Шахові прийоми
description:
You already know many smart chess tricks. In this lesson, you can always use a clever attack to win a piece. We won't tell you which trick to use. It is up to you to figure it out.


After your move, a question appears, asking you what your trick is called. Tick the correct answer.

texts: Two pieces on the same diagonal offer tactical chances!
